pages.title: Law of Regression
pages.text: A counterfeit that holds a little power of its own. Aim at a stone up to twenty-four blocks away and right-click: the tower flies out, fires a beam at the block, and returns to your hand. The aimed block and every stone of the same kind connected to it become the ore of a gem you are carrying — one gem per block.$(br2)The gem spent and the stone struck decide the ore: a deepslate vein becomes deepslate ore, a netherrack one quartz ore, and so on.
Only vanilla gems can be used; coal and metals cannot.$(br2)A cast needs 100 spiritual power from the tower's own bar and has a short cooldown.$(br2)JEI lists every gem and stone the tower accepts.
